description_en: Lists knowledge base build task instances and their run statuses with pagination
description_zh: 分页查询知识库构建任务实例及其运行状态
name: ListKnowledgeBaseBuildTaskInstances

parameters.help_en: The task ID used to filter results
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page
parameters.name: max_results

Code.description_en: The business error code, which is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

Instances.description_en: The knowledge objects that you have permissions to read on the current page
Instances.description_zh: 本页有权读取的知识对象

ConfigSnapshot.description_en: The snapshot of the model, content language, and runtime resources for the execution. This snapshot does not change when the task is updated
ConfigSnapshot.description_zh: 本次模型、内容语言和运行资源快照，不随任务更新改变

ContentLocale.description_en: The content language used for the execution

LlmModel.description_en: The specific model ID actually used and frozen for the execution. AUTO is not returned. This field can be empty for tasks that do not call models, such as pure synchronization tasks
LlmModel.description_zh: 本次实际使用并冻结的具体模型 ID，不返回 AUTO；纯同步等不调用模型的任务可为空

ProjectId.description_en: The DataWorks workspace ID used for the execution, frozen from the task definition when the instance was created
ProjectId.description_zh: 本次运行使用的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID，从创建实例时的任务定义冻结

RuntimeResource.description_en: The resource group and Builder CUs actually used for the execution
RuntimeResource.description_zh: 本次实际使用的资源组与 Builder CU

Cu.description_en: The Builder compute specifications. Valid values: 4 to 16. If omitted during creation, the default value is 4. The read operation returns the effective value
Cu.description_zh: Builder 计算规格，取值 4～16；创建省略时有效值为 4，读取返回有效值

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The DataWorks resource group ID used by the actual Builder nodes. The server verifies its availability in the workspace corresponding to the top-level ProjectId of the task
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 真实 Builder 节点使用的 DataWorks 资源组 ID；服务端校验其在任务顶层 ProjectId 对应工作空间内可用

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created

CurrentStage.description_en: The current business stage, returned when reliable records are available. For standard build stages and semantic model import stages, refer to the domain model. This field does not replace the overall status
CurrentStage.description_zh: 当前业务阶段，有可靠记录时返回；普通构建阶段及语义模型导入阶段见领域模型，不替代整体 Status

Error.description_en: The error code and secure error message returned when the execution fails
Error.description_zh: 失败时的错误码与安全错误信息

Code.description_en: The business error code, which is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Message.description_en: The secure error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

FinishedTime.description_en: The time when the execution finished. This field is optional

GeneratedModels.description_en: The confirmed ModelId and VersionNo for model imports only. For their structure, see GetKnowledgeBaseBuildTaskInstance
GeneratedModels.description_zh: 仅模型导入：已确认的 ModelId、VersionNo，结构见实例 Get 文档

ModelId.description_en: The model ID generated by the semantic layer. You can use it as a KnowledgeObjectId to read the corresponding semantic model
ModelId.description_zh: 语义层生成的模型 ID，可作为 KnowledgeObjectId 读取对应语义模型

VersionNo.description_en: The current version of the SEMANTIC_MODEL being read. Pass this value when updating content. The version can be edited in place
VersionNo.description_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 当前读取的版本；更新内容时传此值，版本可原地编辑

InputSnapshot.description_en: The non-sensitive input snapshot after selection and parsing for the execution. This snapshot does not change when the task is updated
InputSnapshot.description_zh: 本次选择及解析后的非敏感输入快照，不随任务更新改变

DocumentSourceCount.description_en: The number of external document sources selected for the execution. This field is not returned when not applicable
DocumentSourceCount.description_zh: 本次选择的外部文档来源数量；不适用时不返回

FilePaths.description_en: The relative file paths in the knowledge base processed for page upload builds in the execution. These paths are from the frozen upload list of the instance. OSS addresses or verification information are not returned, and the current task or file list is not re-read
FilePaths.description_zh: 页面上传构建本次处理的知识库内相对文件路径，来自该实例冻结的上传清单；不返回 OSS 地址或校验信息，不回读当前任务或文件列表

items.description_en: The relative file paths in the knowledge base processed for page upload builds in the execution. These paths are from the frozen upload list of the instance. OSS addresses or verification information are not returned, and the current task or file list is not re-read
items.description_zh: 页面上传构建本次处理的知识库内相对文件路径，来自该实例冻结的上传清单；不返回 OSS 地址或校验信息，不回读当前任务或文件列表

ResolvedEntities.description_en: The actual Data Map entities resolved from the project, database, or schema scope for the execution. This field is not returned when not applicable
ResolvedEntities.description_zh: 从项目、数据库或 Schema 范围解析出的本次实际数据地图实体；不适用时不返回

EntityId.description_en: The metadata entity ID returned by Data Map. The client must pass this ID as is without concatenating database, schema, or table identifiers
EntityId.description_zh: 数据地图返回的元数据实体 ID；客户端原样传递，不自行拼接数据库、Schema 或表标识

EntityType.description_en: The entity level, such as DATABASE, SCHEMA, or TABLE. The server validates this based on Data Map identities. The presence of an enum value does not guarantee that all engines support it
EntityType.description_zh: 实体层级，如 DATABASE、SCHEMA、TABLE；服务端以数据地图身份校验，不因枚举存在就承诺所有引擎均支持

ResolvedEntityCount.description_en: The total number of resolved entities. An accurate count is returned even if the array is omitted due to its size
ResolvedEntityCount.description_zh: 已解析实体总数；数组因规模未返回时仍可返回准确数量

SelectedInput.description_en: The snapshot of the selection conditions in the task definition when the instance was created. This snapshot does not change when the task is updated. This field is omitted if no fixed object is selected for page upload builds
SelectedInput.description_zh: 创建实例时任务定义中的选择条件快照；不会随任务更新改变。页面上传构建没有固定对象选择时省略

Entities.description_en: The Data Map entities, such as databases, schemas, and tables, selected for data asset-scoped builds. The list is non-empty and deduplicated
Entities.description_zh: 数据资产范围构建选择的数据库、Schema、表等数据地图实体；非空、去重

EntityId.description_en: The metadata entity ID returned by Data Map. The client must pass this ID as is without concatenating database, schema, or table identifiers
EntityId.description_zh: 数据地图返回的元数据实体 ID；客户端原样传递，不自行拼接数据库、Schema 或表标识

EntityType.description_en: The entity level, such as DATABASE, SCHEMA, or TABLE. The server validates this based on Data Map identities. The presence of an enum value does not guarantee that all engines support it
EntityType.description_zh: 实体层级，如 DATABASE、SCHEMA、TABLE；服务端以数据地图身份校验，不因枚举存在就承诺所有引擎均支持

KnowledgeObjectIds.description_en: Required, non-empty, and deduplicated when building from document objects in the knowledge base. Each item is a KnowledgeObjectId with Type=DOCUMENT in the knowledge base. This field cannot be mixed with SourceIds used for external connector synchronization scopes
KnowledgeObjectIds.description_zh: 从本库文档对象构建时必填、非空且去重；每项为本库 Type=DOCUMENT 的 KnowledgeObjectId；与外部连接器同步范围 SourceIds 不混用

items.description_en: Required, non-empty, and deduplicated when building from document objects in the knowledge base. Each item is a KnowledgeObjectId with Type=DOCUMENT in the knowledge base. This field cannot be mixed with SourceIds used for external connector synchronization scopes
items.description_zh: 从本库文档对象构建时必填、非空且去重；每项为本库 Type=DOCUMENT 的 KnowledgeObjectId；与外部连接器同步范围 SourceIds 不混用

ProjectIds.description_en: The DataWorks workspace IDs selected for workspace-scoped builds. The list is non-empty and deduplicated
ProjectIds.description_zh: 工作空间范围构建选择的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；非空、去重

items.description_en: The DataWorks workspace IDs selected for workspace-scoped builds. The list is non-empty and deduplicated
items.description_zh: 工作空间范围构建选择的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；非空、去重

SourceIds.description_en: The IDs of the registered sources in the knowledge base. The list is deduplicated. Whether this field is required and the allowed source types depend on the task input scenario. Refer to the following table
SourceIds.description_zh: 本库已登记来源的 ID，去重；是否必填及允许的来源类型由任务输入场景决定，见下表

items.description_en: The IDs of the registered sources in the knowledge base. The list is deduplicated. Whether this field is required and the allowed source types depend on the task input scenario. Refer to the following table
items.description_zh: 本库已登记来源的 ID，去重；是否必填及允许的来源类型由任务输入场景决定，见下表

YamlUploadId.description_en: The YAML upload session ID in the knowledge base used for SEMANTIC_MODEL import tasks. This ID is bound when the task is created and cannot be mixed with other input scopes
YamlUploadId.description_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 导入任务使用的本库 YAML 上传会话 ID；创建任务时绑定，不能混用其他输入范围

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the instance belongs. Use it for scope validation and queries
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 所属知识库，便于范围校验和查询

StartedTime.description_en: The time when the execution started. This field is optional

Status.description_en: The overall status of the execution

TriggerType.description_en: The trigger type of the execution, which can be manual, periodic, or a supported event
TriggerType.description_zh: 本次由手动、周期或受支持的事件触发

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This field is null if there is no next page
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标；没有下一页时为 null

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

Message.description_en: The secure error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
